name: forensight-evidence-room-icons
colour: currentColor only; one optional filled region per icon marks the item of interest
story: Every symbol is an object from the investigator's evidence room, never a generic UI metaphor.

icons.case-file: Summary: the case folder, everything known so far
icons.replay: Attack story: play the events along the forensic scale
icons.timeline: Timeline: the photo scale with events marked above it
icons.string-board: Attack graph: pins and string on the investigator's board
icons.exhibit-lens: Findings: an exhibit under the lens
icons.attack-map: ATT&CK map: the matrix with the detected cell filled in
icons.host-links: Network: the host and the endpoints it reached
icons.baseline-diff: Baseline diff: the clean baseline (dashed) under the incident sheet
icons.evidence-bag: Evidence: a sealed bag with its exhibit label
icons.signed-report: Report: the document with its signature seal
icons.collector: Live collection: the USB collector, modules in order
icons.ask: Ask the evidence: a question that looks only at the evidence
icons.open-case: New case: a case file being opened
